requires: Separate read/fetch opt-in, detailed callback, restart-aware core and actual exception delivery.
Snapshot of restartable CPU read/fetch producer before callback; the callback cannot certify completion or restartability.
FaultBeforeTransfer plus explicit ExternalBus origin, whole-original-scalar no-transfer including read effects, and present full32bit CPU physical address.
B/W/L requests; ordinary dataFC1/5 or programFC2/6; TT0; no master or pending trace profile; no pending physical writeback or service resumption.
frame: Actual format7 read SSW, exact failed-request size/FC/logical FA, original PC/CCR and genuine address fixups; no invented WB1/WB2/WB3 pending write.
Preserve genuine MOVEM CM calculated EA and explicit guest-RTE/guest-retry flow. RTE itself never performs a hidden operand fetch.
Qualified internalRTE state-load doublefault priority, exception stack/vector halt, default-terminal detailed callback and independent qualified WB1 write profile remain intact.
limits: No ATC/unknown/partial/missing evidence, traced/master/alternate transfer-space or unproved producer continuation.

This is a synchronous empty-cache physical adapter, not a cycle-accurate pipeline or paged MMU model. An earlier completed MOVEM data read can repeat during explicit guest instruction retry; this does not establish arbitrary MMIO restart safety.
Origin and whole-original-request certificates are supplied by the owned fixture. No frontend/backend origin classification or default/native/installer/RC3 behavior is enabled.
